description: This source file defines a custom exception class 'ConnectivityInternalErrorException' used within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity service. It extends runtime exception classes, provides builders, and mechanisms to create instances from messages or JSON data. It encapsulates internal error information for use elsewhere in the project.

classes.name: ConnectivityInternalErrorException
classes.description: A custom immutable runtime exception indicating an internal connectivity error, with builder support to create instances with specific headers, messages, causes, etc.

classes.name: ConnectivityInternalErrorException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class providing a fluent API for constructing instances of ConnectivityInternalErrorException with custom attributes.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new mutable builder for ConnectivityInternalErrorException.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ConnectivityInternalErrorException instance with a specific message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectivityInternalErrorException instance by extracting information from a JSON object.
